sources.label: Morphe android app patches (for apps that I use) - stable releases
sources.author: bearinmind
patch_list: Turns off Samsung Analytics and crash reports.
Makes Samsung Gallery installable and usable on non-One UI ROMs.
Brings back Extract text with an on-device text recognizer.
Turns off Google Maps and Play services location; maps and places are hidden.
Finds photos by what's in them, such as dogs, food or credit cards, with an on-device model.
Ignores policies pushed from Samsung's servers.
